source_metadata.question: The length of the diameter of this spherical ball is equal to the height of the box in which it is placed. The box is a cube and has an edge length of 30 cm. How many cubic centimeters of the box are not occupied by the solid sphere? Express your answer in terms of $\pi$. <image1>
source_metadata.subject: solid geometry

target.visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
target.left_evidence: The dashed horizontal back-bottom edge of the enclosing cube.
target.right_evidence: The central vertical dashed segment from the upper line down to the base.
target.left_meaning: It represents a hidden rear edge of the cube, behind the sphere in the drawing.
target.right_meaning: It is an auxiliary perpendicular projection segment used to construct a right triangle.
target.reason: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right dashed projection ends at an explicit right-angle foot on the base, establishing a planar perpendicular construction. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
